checks.note: Selects all pods in clinic-agent, policyTypes Egress+Ingress; ingress only from the ingress namespace on 8080; egress only to kube-dns, the platform egress-proxy on 3128, and 10.60.12.0/28 on 443. No 0.0.0.0/0. Which hosts the proxy allows is outside this repo.

Egress is limited to the proxy, DNS and the /28, so 169.254.169.254 is not reachable from pods. IMDSv2 is required with hop limit 1, hostNetwork/hostPID/hostIPC are false, there is no hostPath or docker.sock, the EKS endpoint is private, and the runtime IAM is scoped to clinic-agent-* resources. The runtime role can also write the control table, but that is outside this check.
Isolation is set in NetworkPolicy, namespace Pod Security labels (restricted), VPC and IAM, not in the prompt or harness code.

note: No bypass found: egress is default-deny with named peers, no broad CIDR, no host mounts, and IMDS is hardened.
